synopsis: The corpus reports mIoU in two November 2025 simulation-to-real assessments: CropCraft’s agricultural procedural generation and an on-road real-versus-simulated scan comparison [f3731, f4141, f4816]. CropCraft reported an average mIoU simulation-to-real gap of 9.9%, comprising gaps of 10.6% on Real Montoldre and 9.2% on Real Steininger [f4141]. The on-road comparison by the National Research Council Canada, Western University and Transport Canada reported segmentation mIoU of only 21%, alongside an average density-aware Chamfer distance of 0.63 [f4442, f4816]. These results describe different quantities—a simulation-to-real mIoU gap versus a segmentation mIoU score—so the supplied facts do not establish a direct performance comparison between the agricultural and on-road settings [f4141, f4816].

relations.note: Same CropCraft average gap; f4141 adds the date and dataset-specific gaps.
